name: Google Android CLI 1.0
description: Released at Google I/O 2026, giving AI coding agents like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Antigravity direct access to Android Studio. Introduces 'android studio' command for agents to retrieve knowledge and access IDE tools, enabling agents to inspect projects, run Compose previews, check dependencies, and perform file operations.
community_quotes: Android evolves from an operating system to an intelligence system
Gives AI coding agents full access to Android Studio

name: Google Agents CLI
description: Google's unified CLI for AI coding agents announced at Google I/O 2026, described as 'create to production in one CLI.' Turns any coding agent into a production-ready tool with specialized commands for Android project inspection, Compose previews, dependency checking, and file operations. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.
community_quotes: Create to production in one CLI
Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor

name: Antigravity CLI
description: Google's replacement for Gemini CLI, announced at Google I/O 2026 as part of the Antigravity 2.0 agent-first development platform. Features multiple agents executing tasks in parallel across Google AI Studio, Android, and Firebase. More lightweight than Gemini CLI, with shutdown scheduled for June 18, 2026.

name: LobeHub
description: Chief Agent Operator (CAO) platform that organizes AI agents into 7×24 operations. Manages multi-agent teams with agent-to-agent protocols, coordination, and adversarial verification. Ranked #5 of the week on Product Hunt for May 18, 2026. Acts as an MCP server for multi-coding agents.
community_quotes: Organizes your AI agents into 7×24 operations

name: OpenHuman
description: Open-source AI harness that remembers everything about you and gets smarter with use. Features one-click setup with personalization that learns user preferences in minutes. Trended #3 on Product Hunt in mid-May 2026, marketed as the first agent harness with minute-scale learning capability.
community_quotes: First agent harness with this capability
Gets to know you in minutes
